title: Three Springs and One Short Fence
subtitle: 环境保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 环境保护（人与自然·环境保护·环境问题与保护）
meta: 主题语境：环境保护（人与自然·环境保护·环境问题与保护）　|　核心词汇：harm　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 harm 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the keeper ① repaired the harm that no neighbour in the valley would have described, and he said the repairing was the whole of the spring. The ② harm, meaning the damage itself and not the loss, ran three springs and stayed undescribed in the book; harm, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of harm in that valley had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ harm at the far bank, meaning the hurt they kept for the children to see and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Harm, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the keeper said the describing is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the harm was the whole of the matter, meaning the wrong and not the damage. The ⑥ harm, meaning the wrong and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; harm, he said, is either something you repair or the only word that means both a damage and a wrong. He said the wrong is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ harm had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ harm of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in November, was one valley and three springs of describing; harm, he said, is either the hurt at the far bank or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ harm I remember is the harm described in the record, which closed in 1992 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Harm, my mother said in 1994, is the only damage that improves by being described; all harm, she said, is a wrong that has agreed to look like a damage. She said the wrong was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 伤害；损害（指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 伤害；损害（指那些损伤本身，与损失相对）
C. 固定搭配：repair the harm 弥补损害
D. n. 损害（指留给孩子们去看的那一处）
E. n. 危害（抽象总称，指一处山谷的损害之事）
F. n. 伤害（指记录里写到、被记下的那一处）
G. n. 害处；祸害（指一件事里人人都避却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 祸端（抽象总称，指人人都避却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: repaired the harm that no neighbour in the valley would have described
The harm, meaning the damage itself and not the loss
Every kind of harm in that valley
the harm at the far bank
the harm was the whole of the matter
the harm had become a line in a record
The harm of the whole thing

answers.why: repair the harm 意为“弥补损害”，1985 年那位管理员弥补了山谷里没有一位邻居肯描述的损害。
harm 意为“伤害、损害”，指那些损伤本身而不是损失，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被描述。
harm 意为“伤害、损害”，指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一道矮矮的栅栏。
harm 意为“损害”，指最远那处河岸上留给孩子们去看的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
harm 意为“害处、祸害”，指一件事里人人都避却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份祸害就是那件事的全部。
harm 意为“祸端”，指人人都避却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些损害，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
harm 意为“伤害”，指记录里写到、被记下的那一处，到 1990 年这一处成了记录里的一行。
harm 意为“危害”，管理员十一月写道，整件事的损害之事是一处山谷和三个春天的描述。
harm 意为“伤害”，我记得的是记录里描述过的那一处，1992 年修复了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一处。
harm 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，伤害是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的损害。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1985 年那位管理员弥补了山谷里没有一位邻居肯描述的损害，他说弥补才是那个春天的全部。（repair the harm）
那些损害，指的是那些损伤本身而不是损失，经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被描述。（harm）
那处山谷里每一种损害旁边都有同一道矮矮的栅栏。（harm）
最远那处河岸上那处伤害，指的是他们留给孩子们去看的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（harm）
